hint.zh-Hant: 用於貼圖取樣的二維 UV 座標。
hint.en: Two-dimensional UV coordinates for texture sampling.
hint.ja: テクスチャのサンプリングに使用する 2 次元 UV 座標です。
hint.fr: Coordonnées UV bidimensionnelles pour l’échantillonnage de texture.

uniformPresets.name: uAbsTime
uniformPresets.hint: Seconds since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.

uniformPresets.name: uAbsFrame
uniformPresets.hint: Frames since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.

uniformPresets.name: uTime
uniformPresets.hint: Seconds on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline. For time that keeps running, use uAbsTime.

uniformPresets.name: uFrame
uniformPresets.hint: Frame on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline.

uniformPresets.name: uDeltaTime
uniformPresets.hint: Seconds from the previous frame to this one (all of TouchDesigner).

uniformPresets.name: uFrameStep
uniformPresets.hint: Frames from the previous frame to this one; more than 1 when TouchDesigner drops frames.

subgraph.title: Tint
subgraph.description: The simplest Library subgraph: multiplies the input color by another color. Grape flavour by default. The first Library subgraph, made to verify development.

zh-Hant.description: 簡單至極的資源庫子圖：把輸入的顏色乘上另一個顏色，預設是葡萄口味。開發驗證用的第一個資源庫子圖。
